summary.intent: Build an alert agent for the START Hack Munich 'Keep the Line Running' project (Soony), including phone calls, voice, and an installable PWA with push notifications that starts a GPT-Realtime voice conversation when tapped. Most recently, fix the PWA showing only a white screen when reopened on the phone.
summary.outcome: Persisted session state to project memory (status and ask-before-spending feedback), committed nothing. Then started fixing the white-screen PWA reopen issue by rewriting basic_auth.py to use a login flow with manually parsed form body, restarted the service and tested the login flow; final result of that test is not shown.

repo: ask-soony is a private team repo: ask before every push, never commit challenge data, .claude/ and .codex/ are committed, commits authored as josteng with no attribution trailers and one commit per topic.

The tmux serve session runs code loaded from jonas/alerts, while the working tree is jonas/voice-dashboard (based on akshat/dashboard, lacking alerts/openai_calls); restarting serve from this checkout would break the call webhooks.
BasicAuth middleware must read ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD only from the process env, not .env, otherwise Akshat's tests (12) fail.
PWA manifest link behind basic auth needs crossorigin="use-credentials"; iOS push requires Add to Home Screen (iOS 16.4+).
OpenAI Realtime SIP via Twilio needs a project-level webhook (realtime.call.incoming), not the organization-level page.
Twilio trial accepts only Url mode (not inline Twiml) and the shared trial number; German numbers need a business regulatory bundle.

code.finding: Rewritten from plain HTTP basic auth to a login-form flow (next URL encoded, form body parsed manually without adding a dependency) to fix the PWA showing white on reopen from the home screen.
VAPID key stored in data/state/vapid_private.pem (chmod 600); subscriptions in push_subscriptions.json; 404/410 subscriptions dropped on send; /api/push/test returns 409 without subscriptions.

workflow: Before context compaction, persist state into the project's memory directory rather than editing a teammate's PROGRESS.md.
Confirm every paid action (including automatic fallbacks such as buying a phone number) with the user first.
When a dependency is missing for form parsing, parse the body manually rather than adding a package.

friction: Script auto-bought a US Twilio number after the German purchase failed, against the user's expectation.
Twilio trial restrictions (verified numbers, Url-only, KYC, regulatory bundles) slowed voice setup.
Noise handling for realtime calls needed several iterations (semantic VAD, near_field reduction, threshold 0.8).
PWA opened on the phone shows a white screen on reopen, likely related to basic auth behind the standalone app.
Cloudflare tunnel issues: wrong tunnel attached via default config, second-level subdomain cert, QUIC blocked.
open_items: Commit the PWA/push work on jonas/voice-dashboard and the new basic_auth login flow once verified.
Verify the login flow fix on the real phone (white screen on reopen).
Nothing is pushed: jonas/alerts (5 commits), jonas/voice-dashboard and spec commit 84b4134 need explicit OK before pushing; coordinate with Akshat about the voice-dashboard branch.
Hook critical alerts to push.send, test ElevenLabs phone calls, and decide on a German number later.
